grades.reason: The suite does verify exactly this: `describes a Software Architecture workspace by its own subject and types` asserts `prompt.includes(TEMPLATES['software-architecture'].description)` plus all five type names, and `names the workspace, and follows PATCH /workspace when it is renamed` asserts the name before and after a rename.

The `legacy` fixture deletes every EntityType in that workspace (`EntityType.deleteMany`, asserting `deletedCount > 0`) and the `falls back to type names...` test asserts the CATEGORIES fallback appears and that no empty list is rendered, which is the no-types case.

The same `legacy` fixture `$unset`s `template` (asserting `modifiedCount === 1`) and the test asserts the prompt contains neither `Its subject:` nor the default template's description — precisely the no-template fallback.
